mechanism.name: Ferman (2021): two fixed donor types with stationary common AR(1) factors

generation_equations.label: stationary common factors
generation_equations.expression: k=1,2; F_k0 iid N(0,1); F_ks=0.5*F_k,s-1+eta_ks for s=1,...,21, eta_ks iid N(0,0.75), independent across k,s and of the initial states. Omit only s=0; no extra burn-in.

generation_equations.label: unit loadings and noise
generation_equations.expression: N=11,J=10; mu_0=mu_1=...=mu_5=(1,0); mu_6=...=mu_10=(0,1); epsilon_is iid N(0,1), independent of both factor paths.

generation_equations.label: observed outcomes and treatment
generation_equations.expression: Y_is=mu_i^T F_s+epsilon_is+1{i=0,s=21}*post_effect; post_effect=0. G_0=1,G_1:10=0; s=1,...,20 pre and s=21 post. n must equal11.

generation_equations.label: causal target
generation_equations.expression: tau_01=Y_0,21(1)-Y_0,21(0)=post_effect=0 with common exogenous draws held fixed; single-treated SATT and its design expectation are zero.

evidence.expression: F_ks=0.5*F_k,s-1+eta_ks for s=1,...,21, eta_ks iid N(0,0.75), independent across k,s and of the initial states. Omit only s=0

sampling.unit: One jointly generated panel: 11 units (one treated and ten donors), 20 pre periods and one post, represented by one wide row per unit.
sampling.dependence: Two independent stationary Gaussian AR(1) common factors with rho=.5; five donors share the treated loading and five share the second loading. Unit/time idiosyncratic errors are iid standard normal and independent of factors.

assumptions: Consistency, no interference and no anticipation; only i=0 is exposed in the single post period.

Shared common factors with fixed two-type loadings and independent unit/time disturbances; null effect is a structural response restriction. SC estimation quality and identification claims are distinct from the analytic response truth.

properties.notes: No observed baseline covariates are exported. The shared two-dimensional factors and fixed loadings are latent; the observed response equation is linear. Twenty-one outcome columns are not 21 baseline covariates.

estimand.name: tau_01
estimand.definition: Specified treated unit i=0, first and only post period t=1: Y_01(1)-Y_01(0). Its design-population mean and single-treated-unit finite SATT both equal zero pointwise.

truth.expression: Specified treated unit i=0, first and only post period t=1: Y_01(1)-Y_01(0). Its design-population mean and single-treated-unit finite SATT both equal zero pointwise.
truth.derivation: Pointwise identical potential-response exogenous components under both intervention states and post_effect=0; independent rational impulse-response covariance derivation verifies process moments.
